questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Priscilla, the Spider Queen
questions.question: Which of these champions began as the scrapped champion Priscilla?
questions.answer: Priscilla, the Spider Queen was scrapped after she already had an in-game model. After a Petition on the League of Legends forum, Presilla was eventually reworked into Elise. Her original name was Nidalee which was reused and confirmed to have no other relations.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Ao Shin
questions.question: Which of these champions began as the scrapped champion Ao Shin?
questions.answer: Ao Shin was scrapped, and the dragon idea was eventually released as Aurelion Sol. His Storm Dragon skin is a direct tribute to the original concept.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Seth, the Sand Mage
questions.question: Which of these champions was reworked from the scrapped champion Seth?
questions.answer: Riot could not get the Sand Mage concept right in the time it had, and the game could not yet support the visual effects it needed. The idea was reworked into Azir.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Void Ray
questions.question: Which of these champions was reworked from the scrapped champion concept Void Ray?
questions.answer: The airborne champion first appeared on a Battlecast promo blueprint and was later glimpsed in splash art and a recall animation, long before it became Bel'Veth.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Komachi
questions.question: Which of these champions recycled the concepts of the scrapped champion Komachi?
questions.answer: Komachi was planned as a pure tank wielding a scythe, designed by Kuo-Yen 'Xypherous' Lo. When it was shelved, its concepts were recycled for Thresh.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Omen
questions.question: Which of these champions recycled the concepts of the scrapped champion Omen?
questions.answer: Riot shelved Omen because it could not find a suitable personality for it. The name was later reused for an agent in Valorant.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Husk, the Hive Commander
questions.question: Which of these champions grew out of the scrapped champion Husk, the Hive Commander?
questions.answer: Husk was invisioned as a mercenary from Zaun and ex-partner of Caitlyn. The concept was split and used for the two champions: Camille and Kai'Sa.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Magma Chamber and Arena
questions.question: Which game mode recycled the concept of Magma Chamber, a cancelled 2v2 map?
questions.answer: Magma Chamber was first played publicly as a 2v2 map at the 2013 All-Star Showdown. When the 2v2 idea returned as Arena, Magma Chamber became one of its maps.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Magma Chamber and Dominion
questions.question: Which game mode was reworked from Magma Chamber, first announced in 2010 as a 5v5 map and then cancelled?
questions.answer: Dominion was a capture-and-hold mode on the Crystal Scar. It launched in September 2011 and was retired in 2016 because too few people played it.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Dominion map
questions.question: Which map was the Dominion game mode played on?
questions.answer: On the Crystal Scar, two teams fought over five capture points, and holding more of them drained the enemy nexus. The map was removed from the game files in January 2018.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Map removed in 2019
questions.question: Which map was removed from League of Legends in 2019?
questions.answer: Twisted Treeline was a smaller 3v3 map with two lanes that had been in the game since launch. It was retired at the end of Season 2019 because so few people played it.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: The original 17
questions.question: Which of these champions was one of the original 17, released in February 2009?

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: A tribute to Joe
questions.question: Which of these champions says "Bravest hero I ever knew was just a kid. Here's to you, champ.", a tribute to Joe, a young fan who visited Riot through Make-A-Wish?
questions.answer: Joe had Ewing's sarcoma and visited Riot's headquarters through Make-A-Wish. He died in June 2012, and his favorite skin, Jaximus, carries a tribute line of its own: "Here's to you, kid."

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Jaximus
questions.question: Which Jax skin's sales did Riot give to Make-A-Wish in 2012, for a young fan named Joe?
questions.answer: Joe had Ewing's sarcoma and visited Riot's headquarters through Make-A-Wish, and Jaximus was his favorite skin. The skin's line "Here's to you, kid." is a tribute to him.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: "OK."
questions.question: Which of these champions is famous for answering almost every command with "OK."?
questions.answer: Rammus has the fewest quotes of any champion, only six, and is the only one without a joke in English. In several other languages he has a full set of taunts and jokes.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Baron Nashor and Roshan
questions.question: Which game has the boss Roshan, whose name Baron Nashor's is an anagram of?
questions.answer: League of Legends was originally based on Defense of the Ancients, so its biggest neutral monster got a reshuffled version of a DotA name.

questions.subject: item
questions.label: Named after Guinsoo
questions.question: Which of these items is named after Steve Feak, the creator of Defense of the Ancients: Allstars?
questions.answer: According to Feak, Guinsoo's Rageblade was made with Corki in mind. Its icon resembles Guinsoo's Scythe of Vyse, a Defense of the Ancients item also named after him.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: K/DA
questions.question: Which of these champions is a member of the band K/DA?
questions.answer: K/DA debuted with POP/STARS at the 2018 World Championship opening ceremony. Seraphine joined the group for the 2020 EP ALL OUT.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Pentakill
questions.question: Which of these champions is a member of the metal band Pentakill?
questions.answer: In Pentakill's story, a mountain fell on Mordekaiser once he had brought metal to the masses, and legend said whoever drew the axe from its peak would herald a new age of metal.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: True Damage
questions.question: Which of these champions is a member of the band True Damage?
questions.answer: True Damage calls itself a collective of the best artists from around the world, making hip-hop. Its GIANTS music video also gave the first glimpse of Riot Forge.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: HEARTSTEEL
questions.question: Which of these champions is a member of the band HEARTSTEEL?
questions.answer: HEARTSTEEL debuted in 2023 with the song PARANOIA.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Ultimate skins
questions.question: Which of these champions has an Ultimate skin?

questions.subject: text
questions.label: The Mageseeker
questions.question: Which Riot Forge game stars Sylas?
questions.answer: The Mageseeker was made by Digital Sun Games for Riot Forge, a label that worked with studios outside Riot to make League of Legends games.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: CONV/RGENCE
questions.question: Which Riot Forge game stars Ekko?
questions.answer: CONV/RGENCE was made by Double Stallion Games for Riot Forge. Riot stopped making Forge games in 2024, during mass layoffs.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Hextech Mayhem
questions.question: Which Riot Forge game stars Ziggs?
questions.answer: Hextech Mayhem was made by Choice Provisions, one of the outside studios Riot Forge partnered with.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Ruined King
questions.question: Which of these champions is playable in the Riot Forge game Ruined King?
questions.answer: Ruined King was made by Airship Syndicate for Riot Forge. It is a turn-based role-playing game set in Bilgewater and the Shadow Isles.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Arcane studio
questions.question: Which studio produced the animated series Arcane?
questions.answer: Fortiche is a French animation studio based in Paris that had made champion videos for Riot before Arcane.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Arcane premiere
questions.question: Which streaming service did Arcane premiere on worldwide in 2021?
questions.answer: Netflix picked up Arcane for international release in May 2021. Its second season followed in November 2024, released in three acts.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Added in 2024
questions.question: Which neutral monster was added to Summoner's Rift in 2024?
questions.answer: Voidgrubs spawn in the Baron pit, three of them, once per game. Each one killed makes enemy structures burn, and the third summons allied Voidmites to help take down turrets.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Added in 2025
questions.question: Which neutral monster was added to Summoner's Rift in 2025?
questions.answer: Atakhan spawned on whichever side of the river had seen more fighting by 14 minutes. In the lore he is the demon Mordekaiser bound to his service as his Bringer of Ruin.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Tier added in 2023
questions.question: Which ranked tier was added in 2023?
questions.answer: Emerald arrived in Split 2 of Season 2023, between Platinum and Diamond. The promotion series between tiers was removed at the same time.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Tiers added in 2019
questions.question: Which ranked tier was added in 2019?
questions.answer: Season 2019 added Iron at the bottom of the ladder and Grandmaster below Challenger, and cut the divisions in each tier from five to four.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Tier added in 2014
questions.question: Which ranked tier was added in 2014?
questions.answer: Master was added in Season 2014 with a single division, between Diamond and Challenger.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Urf
questions.question: Which animal is Urf, Riot's April Fools' mascot?
questions.answer: Urf began as a 'cancelled' champion in an April Fools' Day joke and has been Riot's mascot ever since, showing up around April 1st. In his story, he idolized Jax above all other champions.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Ultra Rapid Fire
questions.question: Which occasion was the Ultra Rapid Fire mode first introduced for?
questions.answer: In Ultra Rapid Fire, abilities cost nothing and every champion gets 300 ability haste. Recent runs have used All Random picks.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Riot founders
questions.question: Which person founded Riot Games together with Marc Merrill in 2006?
questions.answer: Beck and Merrill were roommates at the University of Southern California. They wanted a company that keeps improving one game after its release instead of moving on to a new one.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Riot owner
questions.question: Which company has fully owned Riot Games since 2015?
questions.answer: Tencent bought a majority of Riot Games in February 2011 and the rest in December 2015.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Release year
questions.question: Which year was League of Legends released in?
questions.answer: League of Legends launched on 27 October 2009, and the 3v3 Twisted Treeline map launched alongside it.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Defense of the Ancients
questions.question: Which game was Defense of the Ancients, the map League of Legends is based on, made for?
questions.answer: Steve 'Guinsoo' Feak, who created Defense of the Ancients: Allstars, was one of the main creative minds behind League of Legends.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Brandon Beck's alias
questions.question: Which of these champions is named after the in-game name of Riot co-founder Brandon Beck?
questions.answer: Ryze was also the first champion to have nine skins.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Marc Merrill's alias
questions.question: Which of these champions shares its name with the in-game name of Riot co-founder Marc Merrill?

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Colt 'Ezreal' Hallam
questions.question: Which of these champions is named after the Rioter Colt Hallam's in-game name?
questions.answer: Ezreal was also the first champion to get a Champion Spotlight video.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Crab species
questions.question: Which of these champions had a species of crab, discovered in 2024, named after them?
questions.answer: The Gothus teemo crab was descoverd in the South China Sea and was named after the board game Go as well as Teemo.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: 100th champion
questions.question: Which of these champions was the 100th champion released?
questions.answer: Jayce was also the first champion with eight abilities, since his ultimate switches between a hammer and a cannon stance with their own spells.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Started as a mode
questions.question: Which Riot game started in 2019 as a game mode inside League of Legends?
questions.answer: Within weeks it took up 20 to 40% of the hours played in League, depending on the region, and Riot made it permanent.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Project A
questions.question: Which Riot game was announced under the codename Project A?
questions.answer: Project A was short for Project Ares. The 5v5 tactical shooter came out on June 2, 2020.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Song of Nunu
questions.question: Which Riot Forge game stars Nunu & Willump?
questions.answer: Song of Nunu is a single-player adventure made by Tequila Works for Riot Forge, in which Nunu searches for his lost mother.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Hailee Steinfeld
questions.question: Which of these champions does Hailee Steinfeld voice in Arcane?

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Ella Purnell
questions.question: Which of these champions does Ella Purnell voice in Arcane?
questions.answer: Ella Purnell voices both the grown-up Jinx and Powder, the girl she used to be. Young Powder is voiced by Mia Sinclair Jenness.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Six against six
questions.question: Which game mode pitted two teams of six players against each other?
questions.answer: Its name comes from the six-kill announcement that only six players per team make possible. It first ran on live servers in February 2014.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Picking for the enemy
questions.question: Which game mode had each player pick a champion for the enemy team?
questions.answer: Nemesis Draft ran only once, in February 2015, and was removed ten days later: players did not enjoy losing the choice of their own champion.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Ascension boss
questions.question: Which of these champions stood at the centre of the map as the boss of the Ascension game mode?
questions.answer: Killing him gave the 'Ascension' buff, which greatly empowered whoever held it. If all ten players danced around him, he danced too.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Doom Bots boss
questions.question: Which of these champions leads the Doom Bots of Doom?
questions.answer: Players have to hold out against his overpowered bots for 15 minutes before he comes down to fight them himself.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Odyssey boss
questions.question: Which of these champions was the final boss of the game mode Odyssey: Extraction?
questions.answer: The 2018 mode was a PvE fight against a series of monsters, and only the other Odyssey champions could be played.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Home of the Poros
questions.question: Which map were Poros first introduced on, in 2012?
questions.answer: Feeding a Poro a Poro-Snax as Braum gives it a mustache in the color of his skin.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Same champion
questions.question: Which game mode has every player on a team play the same champion?
questions.answer: Each player votes for a champion, and the whole team then plays the one that was picked.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Disabled drake
questions.question: Which elemental drake was switched off by a hotfix in early 2022 after negative feedback?
questions.answer: It was disabled in patch 12.2 and came back in 12.22 with new effects and without its fog.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Removed item class
questions.question: Which class of items was removed from League of Legends in patch 14.1, in 2024?
questions.answer: A player could carry only one Mythic item, and its passive grew stronger with every Legendary item they owned.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Edmundo Sanchez
questions.question: Which of these champions is named after Edmundo 'odnumde' Sanchez?
questions.answer: Dr. Mundo's dance references the title character of House, M.D., dancing to Fight the Power by Public Enemy.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Jin Ho Yang
questions.question: Which of these champions is named after his visual effects artist?
questions.answer: During development his name and title were 'Jin, the Artisan Killer' and he was named Jin Ho Yang.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Jeff 'Kassadin' Jew
questions.question: Which of these champions is named after Jeff Jew, later the lead producer of Legends of Runeterra?
questions.answer: The name was Jeff Jew's own nickname, the way Ezreal, Ryze and Tryndamere are named after Rioters' nicknames.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Veigar Bouius
questions.question: Which of these champions is named after a former Riot senior QA analyst who is 'quite tall'?
questions.answer: The analyst was Veigar Bouius. In Legends of Runeterra the champion's name is pronounced 'vy-gar'.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Armored bears meme
questions.question: Which of these champions is named after a forum user's long-running meme about a certain armored animal?
questions.answer: The forum user was Travis 'Volibar' George, who kept championing armored bears in the League.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Guinsoo's dog
questions.question: Which of these champions is named after Steve 'Guinsoo' Feak's dog?
questions.answer: Nunu is also a nickname for his wife.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Maokai Xiao
questions.question: Which of these champions is named after its concept artist, Maokai Xiao?
questions.answer: Maokai was named after his concept artist Maokai Xiao?.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Every letter used
questions.question: Which of these champions was released in 2013 as the first whose name starts with the last unused letter of the alphabet?
questions.answer: Q was the only letter left that no champion's name started with. Qiyana became the second in 2019.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Fewer than five abilities
questions.question: Which of these champions is the only one with fewer than five abilities?
questions.answer: His kit is so unusual that he has his own version of the in-game HUD.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Exclamation marks
questions.question: Which of these champions has an exclamation mark at the end of every ability name?
questions.answer: When Jinx is on the enemy team, Vi and Caitlyn get a cosmetic debuff of their own: 'Catch me if you can!'.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Shields turrets
questions.question: Which of these champions is the only one who can shield turrets?
questions.answer: Shielding a turret can even help her pick up kills.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: First to use energy
questions.question: Which of these champions was the first to use energy instead of mana?

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: First to transform
questions.question: Which of these champions was the first with an ability that transforms them?

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Melee to ranged
questions.question: Which of these champions was the first to be changed from melee to ranged, in patch 9.20?
questions.answer: If he dances after summoning Daisy, she dances along.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Ability named like the title
questions.question: Which of these champions has an ability with the same name as their title?

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: First after launch
questions.question: Which of these champions was the first released after the game's official launch on 27 October 2009?
questions.answer: He came out on 2 December 2009, a little over a month after launch.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Reverted rework
questions.question: Which of these champions is the only one whose gameplay rework was completely reverted?
questions.answer: Her 2017 version was very hard to balance, so Riot put her old kit back. Only the new ability icons were kept.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Fewest quotes
questions.question: Which of these champions has the fewest voice lines in English, and no joke at all?
questions.answer: He has six. Several other languages, such as French, German and Korean, give him a full set of taunts and jokes.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: First Prestige Edition
questions.question: Which of these champions was the first to get a Prestige Edition skin?
questions.answer: She was also the first champion to get chromas on release.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: TFT before League
questions.question: Which of these champions came to Teamfight Tactics before League of Legends?
questions.answer: She was already in development for League, but Teamfight Tactics gave her simpler art of its own for its Into the Arcane set first.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: TFT before League
questions.question: Which of these champions is the only champion to have a non standard Unit radius?
questions.answer: Ivern has a unit radius of 70, instead of one of the standard values of (55/65/80). No one knows why, exactly.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Most songs
questions.question: Which of these League of Legends bands has released the most songs?
questions.answer: Pentakill's three albums hold 30 tracks: 8 on Smite and Ignite (2014), 11 on Grasp of the Undying (2017) and 11 on Lost Chapter (2021). Most of them are named after items.
